purpose: Independent numerical allocation-search diagnosis; not a new efficacy scenario
selection: All 80 primary dates in chronological order; first date used for timing only
capture: Original day runs without additional AC calls; all 240 request vectors saved
reproduction: Retain V1 all-field tolerance results unchanged. Scanning requires identical categories/integers and all remaining numeric fields within 1e-7 native units, except actual_circuit_loss_kw. Every circuit-loss discrepancy is reported separately without being labelled reproduced or changing source data. Captured request totals, allocation totals and factors are independently matched to the original checkpoint.
grid: 65 equidistant points on [0,1], 17 points on [returned rho,1], returned rho plus 1,4,16 times original scalar tolerance
full_request: rho=1 already attains the largest possible factor; retain endpoint data, no interior scan needed to assess a larger factor
detected_miss: Feasible sampled rho > original rho + 2e-5; retain smaller increases as numerical-resolution differences
recheck: All flagged rays are repeated in reverse grid order; detections are not silently discarded
interpretation: No detected miss at this finite grid is not a proof of global optimality; narrow untested islands remain possible
amendment_reason: V1 encountered circuit-loss differences up to 6.071e-6 kW on January 12, while requests, factors, awards, delivery and qualification were identical. Circuit loss is not an input to the allocation predicate or feedback update.
initial_capture_reuse: Use saved V1 vectors and checks after source/key/numeric reconciliation; reuse completed scans only after digest validation. No partial grid is counted complete.
